description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Module' class within the 'slide' namespace, including constructors, thermal modeling functions, state management, and cooling load calculations for a module in a thermal or battery management system.

classes.name: slide::Module
classes.description: Implementation of the Module class managing thermal and electrical states, thermal modeling, and cooling for a system component.

methods.name: Module::Module
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Module with specified parameters, including cooling system setup based on cooltype.

methods.name: Module::setSUs
methods.description: Assigns storage units (cells) to the module, setting parent relationships and updating cell count.

methods.name: Module::checkVoltage
methods.description: Checks the voltage limits of the module and its connected storage units.

methods.name: Module::getVhigh
methods.description: Returns the highest cell voltage within the module.

methods.name: Module::getVlow
methods.description: Returns the lowest cell voltage within the module.

methods.name: Module::getStates
methods.description: Retrieves the states of all cells and the module temperature into a provided array.

methods.name: Module::validStates
methods.description: Validates if the current states of cells are consistent with module constraints.

methods.name: Module::setStates
methods.description: Sets new states for cells and module temperature, with validation and rollback on errors.

methods.name: Module::thermalModel_cell
methods.description: Calculates thermal model for individual cells.

methods.name: Module::thermalModel_coupled
methods.description: Calculates thermal model considering heat exchange with neighbors and coolant.

methods.name: Module::thermalModel
methods.description: Main thermal model function selecting between different thermal modeling approaches.

methods.name: Module::getCoolingLoad
methods.description: Calculates total cooling energy consumption of the module and its children.
